description: Sources of the readings in lookup.db. build_lookup_db.py copies this table into lookup.db as `sources` and records on every lookup row the source that supplied its reading (`source_id`). A merged file is split into one source per layer where byte-pinned records tell its layers apart (`ag_lookup.json#wiktionary`, `ag_lookup.json#expansion`, `mg_lookup.json#rule-paradigms`); a reading no record assigns keeps the file itself as its input. An input not listed under some source's `inputs` stops the build. `share_alike` is true when any component's license requires derived data to carry the same license. The wording follows NOTICE, which remains the authoritative statement of the licenses.
